name: Gabe Vasquez
page_title: Gabe Vasquez's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (NM) - District 2

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Republicans are finding every loophole to control a woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions. This is not freedom. The fight didn’t end with Roe, it’s just beginning. I’ll always be on the side of a woman’s right to choose."

"Today, the House passed the Women’s Health Protection Act, ensuring that Women have autonomy over decisions about their reproductive health. I fully and unequivocally support it, as do 79% of Americans, who support the right to safe, legal abortion protected under Roe v. Wade."
"Women deserve to make their own health care decisions without extremist Washington politicians like Yvette Herrell getting in the way. In Congress I'll vote to codify Roe v. Wade into law."
Rated 91% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "87 years ago Social Security was created and it remains a lifeline for seniors & those living with a disability in #NM02. In Congress I'll fight to protect Social Security & those it helps & oppose cuts or privatization."
"New Mexicans know I’ll fight for the working class, protect women’s healthcare rights, & protect Medicare & Social Security, instead of wealthy CEOs and Wall St. That’s why we’re winning this race!"
Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "During #NationalPoliceWeek, I’m especially proud to cosponsor the bipartisan Invest to Protect Act that will make critical investments in small & midsize police departments, such as those in Las Cruces & Sunland Park, to provide much-needed resources to keep our communities safe."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "I have worked hard to draft a defense bill that improves military housing, strengthens our national security & brings jobs to NM. Why are we debating taking away health care from those who serve our country? Women’s health decisions are between them and their doctor—not the govt."
"I'm committed to advocating for our military installations to ensure NM remains at the forefront of innovation, preparedness & national defense."
Voted in favor of HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "New Mexico will benefit from more than $3.7 billion in investments and create thousands of jobs to fix our roads, deliver drinking water, expand broadband, and reduce energy costs for families. But our current Congresswoman voted AGAINST jobs and infrastructure. We can do BETTER"
"The #InflationReductionAct will provide an historic investment in a clean energy economy that will create good paying jobs in #NM02 & increase our energy independence."

"When we invest in NM, we must invest in the whole state – from our largest cities to our rural towns. Communities like Deming need reliable roads, safe drinking water & affordable energy to grow. That’s why I’m proud to work with @SecretaryPete to bring #NM02 its fair share."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "As your Congressman, I’m committed to cutting through the red tape and helping make sure every family has a safe and affordable home."

"Increases in housing costs currently account for 70% of inflation. That’s unacceptable, which is why I’m proud to cosponsor the Affordable Housing Credit Improvement Act, which will help build 2 million new homes while strengthening and growing the middle class."

"Leaders from Acoma, Laguna and Zuni Pueblos came to discuss the need for federal funding to support housing priorities in tribal communities across New Mexico. Building more homes across our tribal nations is critical to the future success of Indian Country in NM."

"New Mexico is home to over 140,000 veterans. It's our duty to ensure their service is honored—that means fighting everyday to secure affordable housing, healthcare, education and employment assistance for those who served."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "@POTUS and Democrats are using every tool at their disposal to fight for working families by tackling inflation and reducing costs, from capping insulin prices to $35 to reducing disruptions in the supply chain. Republicans have no plan. Let's choose progress over platitudes."

"Increases in housing costs currently account for 70% of inflation. That’s unacceptable, which is why I’m proud to cosponsor the Affordable Housing Credit Improvement Act, which will help build 2 million new homes while strengthening and growing the middle class."

"Inflation and rising prices are having a serious impact on New Mexico families. Record investments to improve our supply chain infrastructure will help, but we must do more to keep costs down for working families."
"The #InflationReductionAct will provide an historic investment in a clean energy economy that will create good paying jobs in #NM02 & increase our energy independence."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "A SCOTUS packed with far-right judges has stripped away affirmative action and student loan debt relief, and has limited the rights of the LGBTQ+ community. Now, more than ever, we need to fight for these rights."

"SCOTUS’ decision on student loan debt relief will disproportionately impact students of color, who bear the brunt of this crisis. Most Latinos owe 83% of their initial student loan 12 years after college. We’ve bailed out corporations and banks, but won’t support students?"
Rated 100% by National Education Association

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "I will always fight to ensure our voting rights are protected and strengthened."

"Rev. Martin Luther King Jr. still has a lot to teach us about civil rights, justice and equity. We can continue to move forward his vision of a more just nation by passing the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act & ensuring that all Americans have a say in our Democracy."

"We must make it easier, not harder, to participate in our Democracy. Ensuring safe, secure & elections is important to all of us - but every voter deserves to have their voice heard & their vote counted. We desperately need voting rights reform."

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "Today, Republicans passed a bill to kill renewable energy investments that impact jobs all across NM - that’s unacceptable. Our approach to energy security must include renewables."
"We can create a two track energy system: responsibly developing oil & gas, while building a renewable energy economy that will create thousands of good paying jobs."

"8,000 new jobs are coming to NM and the surrounding area, thanks to investments that support a 280-mile high-voltage renewable energy transmission line in Hidalgo, Grant to Doña Ana Counties. These are valuable jobs in rural communities that will also help combat climate change! Thank you @RepCiscomani for joining me this week to celebrate this investment in our districts."
"The #InflationReductionAct will provide an historic investment in a clean energy economy that will create good paying jobs in #NM02 & increase our energy independence."

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "Criminal background checks on all gun sales will help keep our communities safer. That's the kind of common sense gun safety law I'll support in Congress."

"I am a sportsman and I support sensible gun regulation. Our kids are dying. Our kids are asking for change. Our society is ailing and unfettered access to firearms is not the answer. It is our responsibility to listen & enact meaningful change. We cannot sit idly by. We must act."
"We can pass common sense gun safety laws & protect our 2nd Amendment rights. Join us tomorrow & help raise money for candidates who will help keep our communities safe. 8 campaigns. 24 hours."

"We must be safe in our homes, businesses & communities. The hateful and violent act at the LGBTQ+ club in Colo. Springs & the recent shooting @ the UNM campus leaves us angry and sad for victims & their families. We must stop hate and stop gun violence. I will work to do my part."

"Our labor leaders have raised the standards for American workers over many generations. They organized, strategized, and demanded change. That fight continues today as we fight for fair wages, paid sick leave, workplace protections, and a more just economy. Happy Labor Day NM"

"Wishing everyone a day of peace & reflection on this Labor Day! Its more important than ever to honor workers by continuing the fight to ensure fair wages, paid sick leave, affordable healthcare, & a fair economy in which anyone who works hard can have a dignified quality of life"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "@POTUS and Democrats are using every tool at their disposal to fight for working families by tackling inflation and reducing costs, from capping insulin prices to $35 to reducing disruptions in the supply chain. Republicans have no plan. Let's choose progress over platitudes."

"The #InflationReductionAct will help lower drug costs by allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices, cap insulin prices for Medicare enrollees & limit Medicare out-of-pocket drug costs. This is a huge win for our seniors in #NM02"

"Yvette Herrell voted against allowing Medicare to negotiate lower drug prices & cap insulin costs under Medicare at $35. She doesn't support lowering costs, she supports higher profits for drug companies."
Voted in favor of HR 5378: "Lower Costs, More Transparency Act"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Spent a few days in the New Mexico Bootheel on the US-Mexico border, and there is no place this beautiful. This is where this crooked, racist administration wants to tear through the landscape to build a needless, ineffective, taxpayer funded wall. #nowall"

"We have the technology to detect fentanyl before it enters our country - why aren’t we using it? Because MAGA Republicans refuse to support my bill, the Smart Border Technology Act, and smart border technology funding. It’s time to put people over politics. Enough is enough."
Rated 11% by NumbersUSA
Voted against HR 2: "Secure the Border Act of 2023"
